effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] This Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) and +3000 DP for the turn.
[Your Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, this Digimon may digivolve into a level 5 Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
